new_checkpoint_rotation_scope: fresh separately admitted contrastive output only
source_observations: Trainer passes save_num_checkpoints_to_keep only into CheckpointSaver constructor.
CheckpointSaver evaluates the original20ba scheduler at the unchanged batch/epoch events.
CheckpointSaver serializes before rotation. Each event records the timestamp mapping and writes a full model/optimizer/RNG checkpoint.
The only keep>=0 branch follows saved_checkpoints.append and invokes _rotate_checkpoints.
For the required unsharded/single-rank local path, _rotate_checkpoints only pops the oldest newly generated pathname and os.remove(s) it.
CheckpointSaver.state_dict serializes all_saved_checkpoints_to_timestamp, not saved_checkpoints or the retention limit. Full timestamp history remains.
Composer RNG serialization uses getstate/get_rng_state getters. Because save events are preserved, any state_dict/metric snapshot side effects occur at identical events.
Author MaxMetricTracker only logs an evaluation maximum and does not select/save/load a best checkpoint.
Original speed_monitor and lr_monitor callbacks, evaluation every20ba, optimizer/scheduler, data order and batch4096 all remain configured identically.
The adaptation selects only the actual epoch1/update2135 final checkpoint with genuine saved Adam step/moment counters, matching the original downstream source.
No resume/autoresume or remote checkpoint uploading is introduced. Fresh local output, empty external loggers and full checkpoint optimizer state remain required.
